gloss: happiness; blessing; bounty (of land or sea)

definitions.explanation: Literary word for happiness or good fortune. Rare in everyday speech but common in formal writing, classical poetry, and fixed expressions.

definitions.gloss: bounty; produce (of the sea or mountains)
definitions.explanation: The natural bounty yielded by the sea or mountains, used in the fixed expressions {海|うみ}の{幸|さち} (seafood) and {山|やま}の{幸|さち} (mountain produce).

examples.japanese: ⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{幸|さち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
{幸|さち}⟦{多|おお}き→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: May you lead a life full of blessings.

examples.japanese: {幸|さち}⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the story of an unfortunate girl.
It's a town rich in seafood.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This dish uses plenty of mountain produce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Autumn is a season when you can enjoy both mountain and sea bounty.

notes:
Literary native-Japanese word. Sense 1 (happiness, blessing) is mostly found in greetings, prayers, and the personal name. Sense 2 (natural bounty) is alive in modern Japanese through the fixed pair ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち} / ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち}, common on restaurant menus and travel writing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち}: seafood; bounty of the sea
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち}: mountain produce; wild plants, mushrooms, game
- {幸|さち}⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: blessed; full of good fortune
- {幸|さち}⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: unfortunate; ill-fated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幸|しあわ}せ: happiness — the modern everyday word
- ⟦{幸|こう}{福|ふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧: happiness; well-being — formal/written
- ⟦{恵|めぐ}み→恵み：10527_megumi⟧: blessing; grace — emphasizes a gift received, often from nature or the divine
